context: A doctor and a student discuss biology terms and reference dictionaries
purpose: Teach: 人工/地下/地上/耐え/苦笑/辞典/ペット/ヒト

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、生物の宿題で「ヒト」ってカタカナで書く理由がわからなくて…
lines.en: Doctor, for my biology homework, I don't get why 'hito' is written in katakana.
lines.style: Polite teen asking with curious, slightly puzzled tone

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ああ、生物学では種としてのヒトを指すときカタカナを使うんですよ。普通の辞典にも載っていますよ。
lines.en: Ah, in biology katakana is used when referring to humans as a species. It's even in a regular dictionary.
lines.style: Calm, instructive medical professional explaining gently

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 辞典で調べたけど、難しい言葉が多くて頭がついていかないんです。
lines.en: I looked it up in a dictionary, but there were so many hard words my brain couldn't keep up.
lines.style: Honest teen complaint, mildly frustrated and casual

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ふふ、それは苦笑するしかないですね。専門用語は地下迷路みたいに繋がっていますから。
lines.en: Heh, all I can do is smile wryly at that. Technical terms are connected like an underground maze.
lines.style: Doctor with a soft, wry chuckle and metaphor

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 地下迷路!たしかに、地上の言葉とは全然ちがう世界ですよね。
lines.en: An underground maze! Really, it's a totally different world from above-ground vocabulary.
lines.style: Teen enthusiastically picking up the metaphor, animated

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: そうそう。最近は人工知能が用語を解説してくれますが、頼りすぎるのも考えものですよ。
lines.en: Exactly. These days AI explains terminology, but relying on it too much is questionable too.
lines.style: Thoughtful doctor offering balanced, mild caution

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わかります。私、暗記に耐えられなくて、つい家のペットに話しかけちゃうんです。
lines.en: I get it. I can't stand memorizing, so I end up talking to my pet at home.
lines.style: Sheepish teen confession with light self-deprecating humor

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: それも立派な勉強法ですよ。声に出すと、辞典の言葉も自分のものになりますから。
lines.en: That's a fine study method too. Saying things aloud makes dictionary words your own.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging doctor validating the student kindly
